notes: v3.0.31 - A write is confirmed only by change. The note-writing verifier in all three typing drivers could mistake a field that was ALREADY full for a landed paste; it now snapshots the field before writing and refuses to confirm anything that did not change it - a failed write reports failed, never saved. Also carries v3.0.30: pulls finish their own visit notes without taking your screen, and with Full visit notes off the pull still saves the pulled day's own encounter note. Requires Chrome 116+.
